xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex14022024-10-21-14-42" status="finalized"> gsuM pa ni <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="9a3"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha cig</rs><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs></note> mkhyen pa gsuM ni dus gsuM car dang 'brel ba rang gzhan <abbr>thams cad</abbr> kyi rgyud la thun mong ba 'phags pa'i gang zag <abbr>thams cad</abbr> <!--Typeset p. 19--> kyi rgyud la skye ba thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab pa'i yul shes bya rgya mtsho lta bu yin la sbyor bzhi chos sku ni bdag nyid dang 'brel ba'i rgyu <lb edRef="inst:4574" n="9a4"/> 'bras kyi gnas skabs mngon rtogs nyung zad skra rtse'i chu tshod tsam yin pas der ci ste mi 'du zhes gsung ngo ||</seg></TEI>
